NonWiki is a verified, source-open digital encyclopedia hosted on [Alexanarch NonWiki](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVwHrOzAV1ATENSidLui36wnmWk6oQXelav2RJvwtugm_4vGnhrSF0XwxF42J4KjeV1l8sWWYsQD--GUhtBfqlw9C1BTS_07poQ-53rA6nuPiE2NQ7Ac5oA). It is constructed as a transparent alternative to traditional crowd-sourced encyclopedias by explicitly locking every assertion to a documented, verifiable source. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVwHrOzAV1ATENSidLui36wnmWk6oQXelav2RJvwtugm_4vGnhrSF0XwxF42J4KjeV1l8sWWYsQD--GUhtBfqlw9C1BTS_07poQ-53rA6nuPiE2NQ7Ac5oA)]
Key Characteristics of NonWiki

* Source-Grounded Entries: Every individual sentence within a NonWiki article explicitly cites its exact source passage. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVwHrOzAV1ATENSidLui36wnmWk6oQXelav2RJvwtugm_4vGnhrSF0XwxF42J4KjeV1l8sWWYsQD--GUhtBfqlw9C1BTS_07poQ-53rA6nuPiE2NQ7Ac5oA)]
* Tamper-Proof Proofs: Each citation links to a saved copy of its source material, complete with its original web address and a cryptographic hash to ensure text integrity. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVwHrOzAV1ATENSidLui36wnmWk6oQXelav2RJvwtugm_4vGnhrSF0XwxF42J4KjeV1l8sWWYsQD--GUhtBfqlw9C1BTS_07poQ-53rA6nuPiE2NQ7Ac5oA)]
* No Public Editing: Unlike traditional wikis, there is no public edit button. Articles are automatically compiled from disclosed data registries and community-disclosed repositories through a published, verifiable sequence. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESWgHrOzAVLssxwFQ8BNHre-zT-0t_u3Htl5khI4ILxoL6rNuAZHKLbEqEI6XLVhCD5m-0cAXH2iJ8HsjefUKeU2LuQet0L72Cyz9B1MSbYJOjZaKPkEanyCHisg), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVwHrOzAV1ATENSidLui36wnmWk6oQXelav2RJvwtugm_4vGnhrSF0XwxF42J4KjeV1l8sWWYsQD--GUhtBfqlw9C1BTS_07poQ-53rA6nuPiE2NQ7Ac5oA)]
* Context in Alexanarch: It acts as a metadata layer for [Alexanarch](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESUwHrOzAVEJIDeXtldPQmobAYhTOpjgRjvNRfKEuOa_fgIwZyieMcuay04AVFnK1NSRpL_XM8yPLsJ6NIUstIJ_3KLU5ZuFsXFH3R8_3jckRz824Y)—a decentralized, sovereign archive built to preserve machine-mediated scholarship, research datasets, and literature against centralized deletion. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESUwHrOzAVEJIDeXtldPQmobAYhTOpjgRjvNRfKEuOa_fgIwZyieMcuay04AVFnK1NSRpL_XM8yPLsJ6NIUstIJ_3KLU5ZuFsXFH3R8_3jckRz824Y), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHrOzAVZrBu7VjZGLjxcGDCACz91em9ULri2mIbAqS5Ju8CywYjzHc5RSQckgEsTGW7lQyQ3o8pbd4qvh6kUdDAtsbyO5AxD8UAhKUjgSfOB5viwc9OcTC1IkcJ2d04dhEW)]

NonWiki can refer to a few different concepts depending on the context:

* NonWiki (Alexanarch): An online encyclopedia of public knowledge with open sources where each article outlines what is known about a specific entity, person, text, tool, field, or poem ([NonWiki — a sourced encyclopedia](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVwHrOzAV3a2GIXHsX5pjsnuEg1Cnp4CMwCVhZfD3MoMwxbIKvDfcWPm1u8OcM3AGAf7hhVoNDAEBvI3LH3vg9FU38eqfnW71g8Ok_g3TLfNheKgWpQ1BXg)). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESVwHrOzAV3a2GIXHsX5pjsnuEg1Cnp4CMwCVhZfD3MoMwxbIKvDfcWPm1u8OcM3AGAf7hhVoNDAEBvI3LH3vg9FU38eqfnW71g8Ok_g3TLfNheKgWpQ1BXg)]
* Nonbinary Wiki: A community platform and open-contribution encyclopedia dedicated to nonbinary identities, which launched in February 2017 to replace the older Nonbinary.org Wiki ([Nonbinary Wiki](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESXQHrOzAVql1ahTKejBJQNo9dQqleA0MuvxCVHHR_9AaEDZ7-GExiUzs3fSASmbHenexf5FXyJNV32n6EZdAjQ2CCjf9W8V4cvpoWWRFwbpXCtJnP1Ygm_8iMcEirmA)). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESXQHrOzAVql1ahTKejBJQNo9dQqleA0MuvxCVHHR_9AaEDZ7-GExiUzs3fSASmbHenexf5FXyJNV32n6EZdAjQ2CCjf9W8V4cvpoWWRFwbpXCtJnP1Ygm_8iMcEirmA)]
* "No Wiki" Gaming: A popular term used by gamers (such as playing Minecraft or complex RPGs "no wiki") to describe playing a game completely on their own without looking up guides, crafting recipes, or walkthroughs online. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHrOzAVeiDKq8qvywDJdDw6swMoesEwqW3xxoktxXnQCMzmq_S_GfNtFMlBvC9Y1bQa_NVOeZVKG4irkOtqn2sWYFD6lLVDxW8iACuuwM71pNj-gRVhAqXnIgp7JwliTZJO7A)]
* Non-Wiki Sites (Wikimedia): Policy and privacy terms referring to websites or services run by the Wikimedia Foundation that do not use standard wiki editing formats ([Wikimedia Foundation Non-wiki Privacy Policy](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHrOzAViikfrCz2-_daqrS9R9WXcnZKd8WqXGjDVw6lvs3oPqhpHnK_xsnF4ly46yEnhzuVuTmer7IlzFhfQsRbQa8NqtB10L0mifLekJe7m-OHImk6Qx0yS0xH_mbHE6pLuDtHUpA)). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESZwHrOzAViikfrCz2-_daqrS9R9WXcnZKd8WqXGjDVw6lvs3oPqhpHnK_xsnF4ly46yEnhzuVuTmer7IlzFhfQsRbQa8NqtB10L0mifLekJe7m-OHImk6Qx0yS0xH_mbHE6pLuDtHUpA)]
